description: Compute the OpenSubtitles hash (moviehash) and byte size of a video file on this computer, for exact-file matching in search_subtitles. Reads only the first and last 64 KiB. Local (stdio) mode only.

file_path.description: Absolute path, or relative to the server's working directory; ~ is expanded

title: Hash a local video file
